sloka: असौ सुतनु शैलेन्द्रश्चित्रकूटः प्रकाशते ।यत्र मां केकयीपुत्रः प्रसादयितुमागतः ।। ६.१२६.४६ ।।
transliteration: asau sutanu śailendraścitrakūṭaḥ prakāśate ।yatra māṁ kekayīputraḥ prasādayitumāgataḥ ।। 6.126.46 ।।

translations.english: "Sita, here is Janasthana, where a mighty tree is seen. Oh sportive lady! There the exceptionally strong and highly energetic vulture Jatayu got killed by Ravana on account of you."
